_why: What each screen still clips when the type dial is at its top and the root is scaled with it. Recorded by scripts/screenshots/typescale.mjs so the number can FALL and never RISE. IT IS ZERO EVERYWHERE, and staying there is the point: every entry used to be the same defect — a work title or a person's name wearing Tailwind's `truncate` — and the rule says a name is never truncated, so they were converted to NameScroll (ui.jsx) and the file is now a floor rather than a debt. A screen that goes above zero has introduced a new one; the answer is to fix it, not to write the number here.
_recorded: 2026-09-01. Was 47 across three screens when first taken (2026-08-30), rose to 98 when the rail took 236px off every screen, and fell to 0 when the 36 name-bearing truncates became NameScroll, the rail learned to drop its words instead of growing, and the timeline's tick row stopped being a px box.
